caption: The drawing depicts a metal wall bracket designed to support a wooden railing. The main focus is a large, detailed illustration of the bracket in perspective, which is affixed to a brown rectangular block that represents a wooden wall or rail. The bracket itself is metallic, depicted in dark shades such as black and gray, and consists of a hexagonal backplate with visible screws at each corner, a central arm that projects outward at an angle, and a circular component connecting the arm to a horizontal support rod. The end of the rod is capped with a rounded knob. To the right, there is a smaller side-view technical drawing in black ink only, showing the bracket in profile supporting a section of the rail and labeled "SCALE 1/3." Below, the illustration shows three identical brackets mounted on a wall in a row, supporting a continuous wooden rail. The background throughout is plain and cream-colored, without any additional elements.
title: Wrought Iron Banister Bracket
